scope: Serial-host analytical characterization for the existing Bell-growth and multi-species oscillatory-backreaction engineering proxies. This record validates bounded analytical extractors, records deck-bound oracle mismatches, and prevents proxy results from being promoted to Section 5.2 or Section 5.3 paper-reproduction closure.

athenak_subject.note: The AthenaK PIC readiness batch contains pre-existing concurrent edits. This bounded tranche added only tst/scripts/particles/pic_q005_q006_local_analytical.py and this sidecar.

q005_bell.disposition: The engineering proxy demonstrates current-driven growth separation, but its measured growth and phase do not match the deck-bound standard no-Hall branch. It is not Section 5.2 analytical-dispersion evidence.

deck_bound_section_5_3_oracle.normalization: ppc=1 split round-robin across two species, rho=1, |q|/m=1, and B_parallel=1

q006_oscillatory_backreaction.disposition: Uniform and SMR have bounded serial proxy parity under the broad extractor, but both traces miss the deck-bound Section 5.3 frequency and are not clean single tones. The nested level-2 AMR deck is short-horizon interface smoke only and cannot qualify frequency agreement.

local_prerequisites_outside_this_tranche: Complete the production coupling and AMR repairs tracked by the readiness plan before freezing publication decks.
For Q-005, replace the engineering proxy with frozen Section 5.2 parameter decks and compare real and imaginary dispersion branches in 1D, 2D, and 3D with declared convergence and seed policy.
For Q-006, replace the engineering proxy with frozen Section 5.3 decks and run long-horizon uniform, SMR, and true AMR frequency-oracle agreement with declared convergence.
mpi: Run Q-005 1D, 2D, and 3D decomposition matrices with an MPI-enabled executable and controlled multi-rank launcher.
Run Q-006 uniform, SMR, and true-AMR decomposition matrices with an MPI-enabled executable and controlled multi-rank launcher.
frontier: Build the frozen Q-005 and Q-006 publication configurations with the Frontier HIP/MPI toolchain.
Execute the declared Frontier rank and GPU matrices, retain logs, and check host-versus-Frontier scientific-metric agreement.
external: Obtain the deferred external-review disposition for the frozen publication decks, oracle formulas, tolerances, retained artifacts, and final Q-005/Q-006 evidence.
